text:
Silver Price in 1988
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1988, the LBMA silver price fell 7.6% between 1988-01-29 ($6.55) and 1988-12-30 ($6.05). The highest sampled price was $6.80 in July and the lowest was $6.05 in December. The mean of these observations was $6.42. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
